page_title: EVE 0-1 FUL | Everton v Fulham 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Stuart Attwell is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+7' Michael Keane (Everton) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Bernd Leno, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+7' The foul by Andreas Pereira (Fulham) was seen by Stuart Attwell who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+6' Bernd Leno makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) after a cross from the side.
90+4' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

90+4' What a chance that is! Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
90+1' Marco Silva (Fulham) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+1' James Tarkowski (Everton) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alex Iwobi (Everton) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
90' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Bernd Leno (Fulham).
89' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Fulham) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance.
87' Kenny Tete (Fulham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
85' Michael Keane (Everton) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
85' Alex Iwobi (Everton) prepares to take a corner kick.
85' A nice lofted cross finds Alex Iwobi (Everton) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the bottom right post, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save!
83' A substitution has been made. James Garner is replaced by Lewis Dobbin (Everton).

83' James Tarkowski (Everton) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Bernd Leno makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
83' Nathan Patterson (Everton) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
81' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
80' James Garner (Everton) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
79' The attendance is 39940.
78' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.

73' 0 - 1 Goal! Andreas Pereira manages to prod the ball to Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
72' Neal Maupay will be replaced by Arnaut Danjuma (Everton).
71' A lofted cross from James Garner (Everton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
70' Harry Wilson (Fulham) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
68' Nathan Patterson (Everton) hits the crossbar with a rebound from near the penalty spot.
68' Alex Iwobi (Everton) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Bernd Leno is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
68' Ashley Young (Everton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
66' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Fulham) is able to continue to play.
64' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Fulham) picks up an injury.
63' James Garner (Everton) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
62' James Garner (Everton) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
62' An attempted cross from James Garner (Everton) is cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Everton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Ashley Young (Everton) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of James Garner, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
60' James Garner (Everton) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
60' The free kick from long range, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Tom Cairney is replaced by Andreas Pereira (Fulham).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aleksandar Mitrovic (Fulham) replaces Raul Jimenez.

58' OFF THE POST! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
56' James Tarkowski (Everton) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
55' Tom Cairney (Fulham) sends a low pass into the box, towards Antonee Robinson. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
55' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Amadou Onana (Everton) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
53' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) hits a first-time volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort is way off target and the ball goes well wide of the right post.
53' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Harrison Reed (Fulham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
52' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
51' Neal Maupay (Everton) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
49' Nathan Patterson (Everton) tries to find James Garner, but he puts too much power on the pass.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Silva probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Willian (Fulham). He is replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45+1' Neal Maupay (Everton) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
42' Neal Maupay (Everton) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Bernd Leno to make a comfortable save.
40' Neal Maupay (Everton) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
36' Goal disallowed! Michael Keane (Everton) scores but Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
36' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Everton.
35' Neal Maupay (Everton) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Bernd Leno, who pulls off a stunning save!
33' Kenny Tete (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

32' James Tarkowski (Everton) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the left side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Bernd Leno, who keeps it out.
30' Yellow card. Willian (Fulham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
29' James Garner (Everton) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
27' Willian (Fulham) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
23' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
21' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Alex Iwobi (Everton), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
19' A cross from a corner kick by Everton is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

19' Alex Iwobi (Everton) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and fires a low shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort. It will be a corner kick for Everton.
17' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
16' Alex Iwobi (Everton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Kenny Tete (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
12' Fulham have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
10' James Tarkowski (Everton) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
6' None of the Everton players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

5' Bernd Leno pulls off a great save to deny Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal. Everton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Fulham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
3' Tom Cairney (Fulham) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
3' Corner kick. Willian (Fulham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
3' A pass by Sasa Lukic (Fulham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
2' Neal Maupay (Everton) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
